text: 金十数据8月28日讯，证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。支持上市房地产开发企业再融资。强化资本市场功能发挥，支持上市房地产开发企业通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，募集资金应当投向符合政策要求的市场化房地产项目，负责实施的项目开发公司应当符合监管要求。对于境外上市房地产开发企业再融资的，依照有关规定持续做好相关备案工作。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. Support refinancing by listed real estate development companies. Strengthen the role of the capital market, supporting listed real estate development companies to conduct refinancing through issuance to specific targets, with raised funds directed to market-oriented real estate projects meeting policy requirements, and the project development companies responsible for implementation should meet regulatory requirements. For refinancing by overseas-listed real estate development companies, continue to complete relevant filing procedures in accordance with relevant regulations.
